description: Unsigned transactions to close a gAIX short through Goldstein's pool (amount: gAIX to buy back, or all: true): the gAIX is bought with the USDG held, any shortfall from the wallet, and what is left comes back. Goes through while the hook takes at most 4%; over that, or for a sliver of debt, use gaix_short_close_in_kind. While the desk is paused a close is whole. Simulated from the wallet.

all.description: true closes or takes out everything

amount.description: gAIX to buy back, as a decimal string

wallet.description: The wallet's address (0x...); the transactions are built for it to sign

name: gaix_short_close
title: Prepare: close a gAIX short through the pool
